mutations.name: partitionTools drops the default allowlist gate — Read/Glob/Edit, whose translators exist for protocol-matrix work but whose intent is LOCAL execution, become natively mapped by default: this is the #124 shape, where the cascade planner runs the tool in the remote workspace sandbox and Claude Code hangs until the warm stall fires

the OFF kill-switch stops being consulted — WINDSURFAPI_NATIVE_TOOL_BRIDGE_OFF=1 is documented as the highest-priority override, so removing the check turns an operator's emergency stop into a no-op while an explicit WINDSURFAPI_NATIVE_TOOL_BRIDGE=1 keeps routing tools to the remote sandbox

the all_mapped precondition is dropped — all_mapped mode now fires with unmapped tools still declared, so the planner gets a native allowlist that cannot serve them while the emulation toolPreamble no longer carries their schemas: the exact 'tool exists but the model cannot call it' failure partition mode was written to avoid

NATIVE_XML_BODY_MAX is raised past any plausible block — an unclosed <function_calls> block is no longer dropped, so the stream parser holds upstream output in this.buffer without bound instead of discarding it, turning a malformed model response into unbounded RSS growth on a long stream

partialFunctionCallsPrefixLength never holds a partial opening tag — a delta that ends mid-`<function_calls` is flushed straight to the client, so the raw provider-native XML marker leaks into user-visible output and the block can never be reassembled into a tool_call when the rest arrives

the non-stream parser keeps a dangling <function_calls> block instead of cutting it — an incomplete native block is echoed back as literal XML in the assistant text (the same leak the stream path bounds), and the partial marker is visible to the caller's UI

an invoke for a tool the caller never declared is still converted — the callerLookup miss is treated as 'use identity args', so the proxy invents a tool_call for a tool absent from the request's tools[]; a strict client rejects the whole response, and a lenient one executes an unadvertised tool

the assistant→tool history overlay writes an empty observation — the tool result never reaches the additional_steps body, so the planner is told 'this step ran' with no output and re-runs or fabricates the result instead of reasoning from it
